## Database Schema
Table: bok_economic_indicators
Description: Bank of Korea economic indicators
Primary Key: (stat_code, time_value, item_code1)
Columns:
- stat_code (VARCHAR): Statistics code
- stat_name (VARCHAR): Indicator name (Base rate, GDP, CPI, Producer Price Index, Consumer Price Index, Export/Import Price Index, Economic Sentiment Index, News Sentiment Index)
- item_code1 (VARCHAR): Item code 1
- item_name1 (VARCHAR): Item name 1
- item_code2 (VARCHAR): Item code 2
- item_name2 (VARCHAR): Item name 2
- item_code3 (VARCHAR): Item code 3
- item_name3 (VARCHAR): Item name 3
- item_code4 (VARCHAR): Item code 4
- item_name4 (VARCHAR): Item name 4
- unit_name (VARCHAR): Unit name
- wgt (NUMERIC): Weight
- cycle (CHAR): Frequency (A=Annual, Q=Quarterly, M=Monthly, D=Daily)
- time_value (DATE): Date
- time_original (VARCHAR): Original time string
- data_value (NUMERIC): Indicator value
- created_at (TIMESTAMP): Record creation time
- updated_at (TIMESTAMP): Last update time
Usage: Korean macroeconomic data queries, economic indicator analysis

## Term Mapping
## Price/Quote Terms
- 현재가, 종가 -> close
- 시가 -> open
- 고가 -> high
- 저가 -> low
- 거래량 -> volume
- 거래대금 -> trading_value
- 시총, 시가총액 -> market_cap
- 등락률, 변동률 -> change_rate

## Technical Indicators (in kr_indicators or us_indicators)
- RSI, 알에스아이 -> rsi
- MACD -> macd, macd_signal, macd_hist
- 볼린저밴드 -> real_upper_band, real_middle_band, real_lower_band
- 이평선, 이동평균, SMA -> sma
- EMA, 지수이동평균 -> ema
- VWAP -> vwap, eod_vwap, avg_vwap
- ATR -> atr
- 스토캐스틱 -> slowk, slowd
- MFI -> mfi
- ADX -> adx
- ROC -> roc
- OBV -> obv
- CCI -> cci

## Conditions
- 과매수 -> rsi > 70
- 과매도 -> rsi < 30
- 골든크로스 -> macd > macd_signal
- 데드크로스 -> macd < macd_signal
- 대형주 -> market_cap >= 10000000000000 (10 trillion KRW)
- 중형주 -> market_cap >= 1000000000000 AND market_cap < 10000000000000
- 상한가 -> change_rate >= 29.9
- 하한가 -> change_rate <= -29.9

## Investor Types (Korean market only, from kr_individual_investor_daily_trading)
- 외국인, 외인 -> foreign_net_volume, foreign_net_value
- 기관 -> inst_net_volume, inst_net_value
- 개인, 개미 -> retail_net_volume, retail_net_value
- 순매수 -> net_volume > 0
- 순매도 -> net_volume < 0

## Quant Grades (from kr_stock_grade / us_stock_grade)
- 종합등급, 투자등급 -> final_grade
- 종합점수, 최종점수 -> final_score
- 가치점수 -> value_score
- 퀄리티점수, 품질점수 -> quality_score
- 모멘텀점수 -> momentum_score
- 성장점수 -> growth_score
- 신뢰도점수 -> confidence_score
- 매수 등급 -> final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수')
- 강력 매수 -> final_grade = '강력 매수'
- 매수 고려 이상 -> final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수', '매수 고려')
- 매도 등급 -> final_grade IN ('매도', '강력 매도')

## Market Index
- 코스피 -> exchange = 'KOSPI'
- 코스닥 -> exchange = 'KOSDAQ'
- 나스닥 -> exchange = 'NASDAQ'
- 뉴욕증시 -> exchange = 'NYSE'

## Question
우리나라 기준금리가 어떻게 변동되었는지 알려주세요

SELECT stat_name, item_name1, time_value, data_value, unit_name
FROM bok_economic_indicators
WHERE stat_name LIKE '%기준금리%' OR item_name1 LIKE '%기준금리%'
ORDER BY time_value DESC
LIMIT 12

## Question
미국 CPI가 전년 동월 대비 5% 이상 상승한 고인플레이션 기간과 2% 이하인 저인플레이션 기간에서 VIX와 주요 지수의 변동성 패턴을 비교하고, 각 인플레이션 구간별 시장 스트레스 지표를 분석해주세요.

WITH cpi_regimes AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    value as cpi_rate,
    CASE 
      WHEN value >= 5.0 THEN 'HIGH_INFLATION'
      WHEN value <= 2.0 THEN 'LOW_INFLATION'
      ELSE 'MODERATE_INFLATION'
    END as inflation_regime
  FROM us_cpi
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
vix_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    c.inflation_regime,
    v.date,
    v.value as vix_level,
    CASE 
      WHEN v.value >= 30 THEN 'EXTREME_FEAR'
      WHEN v.value >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_FEAR'
      ELSE 'LOW_FEAR'
    END as fear_level
  FROM cpi_regimes c
  JOIN us_vix v ON v.date BETWEEN c.date - INTERVAL '15 days' AND c.date + INTERVAL '15 days'
  WHERE c.inflation_regime IN ('HIGH_INFLATION', 'LOW_INFLATION')
),
market_volatility AS (
  SELECT 
    c.inflation_regime,
    m.exchange,
    m.date,
    ABS(m.change_rate) as daily_volatility,
    m.change_rate
  FROM cpi_regimes c
  JOIN market_index m ON m.date BETWEEN c.date - INTERVAL '15 days' AND c.date + INTERVAL '15 days'
  WHERE c.inflation_regime IN ('HIGH_INFLATION', 'LOW_INFLATION')
    AND m.exchange IN ('KOSPI', 'NASDAQ', 'NYSE')
),
stress_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    v.inflation_regime,
    AVG(v.vix_level) as avg_vix,
    STDDEV(v.vix_level) as vix_volatility,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN v.fear_level = 'EXTREME_FEAR' THEN 1 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) * 100 as extreme_fear_pct,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN v.fear_level = 'HIGH_FEAR' THEN 1 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) * 100 as high_fear_pct
  FROM vix_analysis v
  GROUP BY v.inflation_regime
),
market_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    m.inflation_regime,
    m.exchange,
    AVG(m.daily_volatility) as avg_volatility,
    STDDEV(m.daily_volatility) as volatility_of_volatility,
    AVG(m.change_rate) as avg_return,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.change_rate < -2 THEN 1 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) * 100 as sharp_decline_pct,
    MIN(m.change_rate) as worst_daily_return,
    MAX(m.change_rate) as best_daily_return
  FROM market_volatility m
  GROUP BY m.inflation_regime, m.exchange
)
SELECT 
  s.inflation_regime,
  'VIX_STRESS_METRICS' as metric_type,
  NULL as exchange,
  ROUND(s.avg_vix::NUMERIC, 2) as avg_value,
  ROUND(s.vix_volatility::NUMERIC, 2) as volatility,
  ROUND(s.extreme_fear_pct::NUMERIC, 1) as extreme_stress_pct,
  ROUND(s.high_fear_pct::NUMERIC, 1) as high_stress_pct,
  NULL as avg_return,
  NULL as worst_return
FROM stress_metrics s
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  m.inflation_regime,
  'MARKET_VOLATILITY' as metric_type,
  m.exchange,
  ROUND(m.avg_volatility::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_value,
  ROUND(m.volatility_of_volatility::NUMERIC, 3) as volatility,
  ROUND(m.sharp_decline_pct::NUMERIC, 1) as extreme_stress_pct,
  NULL as high_stress_pct,
  ROUND(m.avg_return::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_return,
  ROUND(m.worst_daily_return::NUMERIC, 2) as worst_return
FROM market_stats m
ORDER BY inflation_regime, metric_type, exchange NULLS FIRST

## Question
최근 분기 실적 발표 후 애널리스트들의 EPS 컨센서스가 상향 조정(지난 30일간 상향 리비전 > 하향 리비전)된 종목들 중에서, 퀀트 모델의 성장점수가 80점 이상이면서 현재 주가가 52주 고점 대비 10% 이내에 있는 종목들을 분석하세요.

WITH latest_trading_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) as max_date FROM us_daily
),
latest_estimates AS (
  SELECT symbol, estimate_date, horizon,
         eps_estimate_average, eps_estimate_average_30_days_ago,
         eps_estimate_revision_up_trailing_30_days,
         eps_estimate_revision_down_trailing_30_days,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol, horizon ORDER BY estimate_date DESC) as rn
  FROM us_earnings_estimates
  WHERE horizon = 'next fiscal year'
),
positive_revisions AS (
  SELECT symbol
  FROM latest_estimates
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND eps_estimate_revision_up_trailing_30_days > eps_estimate_revision_down_trailing_30_days
    AND eps_estimate_average > eps_estimate_average_30_days_ago
),
high_growth_stocks AS (
  SELECT d.symbol, d.close, d.change_rate, d.volume,
         b.stock_name, b.sector, b.week52high, b.market_cap,
         g.growth_score, g.final_score, g.final_grade,
         g.momentum_score, g.quality_score,
         est.eps_estimate_average, est.eps_estimate_average_30_days_ago,
         est.eps_estimate_revision_up_trailing_30_days,
         est.eps_estimate_revision_down_trailing_30_days,
         ROUND((d.close / b.week52high * 100), 2) as price_vs_52w_high
  FROM us_daily d
  INNER JOIN us_stock_basic b ON d.symbol = b.symbol
  INNER JOIN us_stock_grade g ON d.symbol = g.symbol AND g.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM us_stock_grade) AND d.date = g.date
  INNER JOIN positive_revisions pr ON d.symbol = pr.symbol
  INNER JOIN latest_estimates est ON d.symbol = est.symbol AND est.rn = 1
  CROSS JOIN latest_trading_date ltd
  WHERE d.date = ltd.max_date
    AND g.growth_score >= 80
    AND b.week52high > 0
    AND (d.close / b.week52high) >= 0.90
)
SELECT symbol, stock_name, sector,
       close, ROUND(change_rate, 2) as change_rate,
       price_vs_52w_high,
       growth_score, momentum_score, quality_score, final_score,
       final_grade,
       ROUND(eps_estimate_average, 2) as current_eps_est,
       ROUND(eps_estimate_average_30_days_ago, 2) as eps_est_30d_ago,
       ROUND(((eps_estimate_average - eps_estimate_average_30_days_ago) / eps_estimate_average_30_days_ago * 100), 2) as eps_revision_pct,
       eps_estimate_revision_up_trailing_30_days as up_revisions,
       eps_estimate_revision_down_trailing_30_days as down_revisions,
       ROUND(market_cap/1000000000, 2) as market_cap_b
FROM high_growth_stocks
ORDER BY growth_score DESC, price_vs_52w_high DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH high_iv_stocks AS (SELECT symbol, iv_percentile, final_grade, final_score FROM us_stock_grade WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM us_stock_grade) AND iv_percentile >= 80), oversold_rsi AS (SELECT symbol, rsi, date FROM us_indicators WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM us_indicators) AND rsi <= 30), undervalued_analysis AS (SELECT h.symbol, h.iv_percentile, h.final_grade, h.final_score, r.rsi, b.analysttargetprice, d.close, CASE WHEN b.analysttargetprice > 0 AND d.close > 0 THEN ((b.analysttargetprice - d.close) / d.close) * 100 ELSE NULL END as upside_potential, b.stock_name, b.sector, b.industry, b.market_cap, d.change_rate, d.volume, d.avg_volume_20d FROM high_iv_stocks h JOIN oversold_rsi r ON h.symbol = r.symbol JOIN us_stock_basic b ON h.symbol = b.symbol LEFT JOIN us_daily d ON h.symbol = d.symbol AND d.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM us_daily WHERE symbol = h.symbol) WHERE b.analysttargetprice IS NOT NULL AND d.close IS NOT NULL), filtered_opportunities AS (SELECT symbol, stock_name, sector, iv_percentile, rsi, analysttargetprice, close, upside_potential, final_grade, final_score, market_cap, change_rate, volume, avg_volume_20d, (volume::NUMERIC / NULLIF(avg_volume_20d, 0)) as volume_ratio FROM undervalued_analysis WHERE upside_potential >= 20) SELECT symbol, stock_name, sector, iv_percentile, rsi, analysttargetprice, close, ROUND(upside_potential, 2) as upside_potential_pct, final_grade, final_score, market_cap, change_rate, ROUND(volume_ratio, 2) as volume_vs_20d_avg, CASE WHEN final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수') THEN 'High Conviction' WHEN final_grade = '매수 고려' THEN 'Moderate Conviction' ELSE 'Low Conviction' END as investment_conviction FROM filtered_opportunities ORDER BY upside_potential DESC, final_score DESC

## Question
연준 금리 인상/인하 사이클별로 한국과 미국 주요 지수의 성과를 비교하고, 각 사이클에서 금리 변동 방향과 시장 수익률의 상관관계를 분석해주세요.

WITH fed_rate_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    value as fed_rate,
    LAG(value) OVER (ORDER BY date) as prev_fed_rate,
    value - LAG(value) OVER (ORDER BY date) as rate_change
  FROM us_fed_funds_rate
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY date
),
rate_cycles AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    fed_rate,
    rate_change,
    CASE 
      WHEN rate_change > 0.1 THEN 'HIKING'
      WHEN rate_change < -0.1 THEN 'CUTTING'
      WHEN rate_change BETWEEN -0.1 AND 0.1 THEN 'STABLE'
    END as cycle_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rate_change > 0.1 OR rate_change < -0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
      OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as cycle_id
  FROM fed_rate_changes
  WHERE rate_change IS NOT NULL
),
market_performance AS (
  SELECT 
    r.cycle_type,
    r.cycle_id,
    m.exchange,
    AVG(m.change_rate) as avg_daily_return,
    STDDEV(m.change_rate) as return_volatility,
    COUNT(*) as trading_days,
    MIN(r.date) as cycle_start,
    MAX(r.date) as cycle_end
  FROM rate_cycles r
  JOIN market_index m ON m.date BETWEEN r.date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND r.date + INTERVAL '30 days'
  WHERE r.cycle_type IN ('HIKING', 'CUTTING')
    AND m.exchange IN ('KOSPI', 'NASDAQ')
  GROUP BY r.cycle_type, r.cycle_id, m.exchange
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
)
SELECT 
  cycle_type as fed_policy,
  exchange as market_index,
  COUNT(*) as cycle_count,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_daily_return)::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_daily_return_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(return_volatility)::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_volatility_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_daily_return * trading_days)::NUMERIC, 2) as avg_cumulative_return,
  ROUND((AVG(avg_daily_return) / NULLIF(AVG(return_volatility), 0))::NUMERIC, 3) as risk_adjusted_return
FROM market_performance
GROUP BY cycle_type, exchange
ORDER BY cycle_type, exchange

Table: kr_stock_grade
Description: Korean stock quant analysis model results
Primary Key: (symbol, date)
Columns:
- stock_name (VARCHAR): Stock name
- symbol (VARCHAR): Stock code
- date (DATE): Analysis date (based on kr_intraday_total latest data)
- final_grade (VARCHAR): Investment grade (강력 매수, 매수, 매수 고려, 중립, 매도 고려, 매도, 강력 매도)
- final_score (NUMERIC): Final score (0-100): base_factor_score*0.36 + sector_rotation_score*0.25 + factor_combination_bonus*0.39
- value_score (NUMERIC): Value factor weighted score (0-100)
- quality_score (NUMERIC): Quality factor weighted score (0-100)
- momentum_score (NUMERIC): Momentum factor weighted score (0-100)
- growth_score (NUMERIC): Growth factor weighted score (0-100)
- confidence_score (NUMERIC): Confidence score (%): data completeness(70%) + 4 factor existence(30%)
- var_95 (NUMERIC): Daily VaR 95% (negative, %): 5th percentile of 90-day daily returns
- cvar_95 (NUMERIC): Daily CVaR 95% (negative, %): mean of returns below VaR 95%
- inst_net_30d (BIGINT): Institution 30-day net volume
- foreign_net_30d (BIGINT): Foreign 30-day net volume
- value_momentum (NUMERIC): Value factor momentum: value_score - 50
- quality_momentum (NUMERIC): Quality factor momentum: quality_score - 50
- momentum_momentum (NUMERIC): Momentum factor momentum: momentum_score - 50
- growth_momentum (NUMERIC): Growth factor momentum: growth_score - 50
- industry_rank (INTEGER): Industry rank by market cap
- industry_percentile (NUMERIC): Industry percentile (%)
- beta (NUMERIC): Beta coefficient estimate
- volatility_annual (NUMERIC): Annualized volatility (%)
- max_drawdown_1y (NUMERIC): 1-year max drawdown (negative, %)
- risk_profile_text (TEXT): Risk profile interpretation
- risk_recommendation (TEXT): Investor suitability recommendation
- time_series_text (TEXT): Time series trend interpretation
- signal_overall (TEXT): Overall signal evaluation
- market_state (VARCHAR): Market state classification (19 dimensions)
- rs_value (NUMERIC): Relative Strength value (%): stock 20d return - market avg 20d return
- rs_rank (TEXT): Relative Strength grade (Very Strong, Strong, Neutral, Weak, Very Weak)
- factor_combination_bonus (INTEGER): Factor combination bonus (0-100 normalized)
- sector_rotation_score (INTEGER): Sector rotation score (0-100)
- sector_momentum (NUMERIC): Sector momentum (%): sector avg 30d return
- sector_rank (INTEGER): Sector rank by return
- sector_percentile (NUMERIC): Sector percentile (top X%)
- value_v2_detail (JSONB): Value factor strategy details JSON
- quality_v2_detail (JSONB): Quality factor strategy details JSON
- momentum_v2_detail (JSONB): Momentum factor strategy details JSON
- growth_v2_detail (JSONB): Growth factor strategy details JSON
- entry_timing_score (NUMERIC): Entry timing score (0-100)
- score_trend_2w (NUMERIC): 2-week final_score change
- price_position_52w (NUMERIC): 52-week high/low position (0-100%)
- stop_loss_pct (NUMERIC): Stop loss % (negative): -2 * ATR%
- take_profit_pct (NUMERIC): Take profit % (positive): +3 * ATR%
- risk_reward_ratio (NUMERIC): Risk/reward ratio (default 1.5)
- position_size_pct (NUMERIC): Recommended portfolio weight (%)
- atr_pct (NUMERIC): ATR% (14-day)
- scenario_bullish_prob (INTEGER): Bullish scenario probability (%)
- scenario_sideways_prob (INTEGER): Sideways scenario probability (%)
- scenario_bearish_prob (INTEGER): Bearish scenario probability (%)
- scenario_bullish_return (VARCHAR): Bullish expected return range
- scenario_sideways_return (VARCHAR): Sideways expected return range
- scenario_bearish_return (VARCHAR): Bearish expected return range
- scenario_sample_count (INTEGER): Scenario analysis sample count
- buy_triggers (JSONB): Buy trigger conditions JSON array
- sell_triggers (JSONB): Sell trigger conditions JSON array
- hold_triggers (JSONB): Hold trigger conditions JSON array
- sharpe_ratio (NUMERIC): Sharpe ratio
- sortino_ratio (NUMERIC): Sortino ratio
- calmar_ratio (NUMERIC): Calmar ratio
- strategy (JSON): Multi AI agent investment strategy analysis
- hurst_exponent (FLOAT): Hurst exponent (0-1): <0.5 mean reversion, =0.5 random walk, >0.5 trend persistence
- var_95_ewma (FLOAT): EWMA VaR 95% (%): exponentially weighted moving average volatility based VaR
- var_95_5d (FLOAT): 5-day VaR 95% (negative, %)
- var_95_20d (FLOAT): 20-day VaR 95% (negative, %)
- var_95_60d (FLOAT): 60-day VaR 95% (negative, %)
- var_99 (FLOAT): Daily VaR 99% (negative, %)
- var_99_60d (FLOAT): 60-day VaR 99% (negative, %)
- inv_vol_weight (FLOAT): Inverse volatility weight
- downside_vol (FLOAT): Downside volatility (%)
- vol_percentile (FLOAT): Volatility percentile (%)
- atr_20d (FLOAT): ATR 20-day (KRW)
- atr_pct_20d (FLOAT): ATR% 20-day (%)
- cvar_99 (FLOAT): CVaR 99% (negative, %)
- corr_kospi (FLOAT): KOSPI correlation (-1 to 1)
- corr_sector_avg (FLOAT): Sector average correlation (-1 to 1)
- tail_beta (FLOAT): Tail Beta: beta during market decline (<-5%)
- drawdown_duration_avg (FLOAT): Average drawdown duration (trading days)
- conviction_score (NUMERIC): Conviction score (0-100): based on consistency of 4 factor scores - lower std dev = higher score
- outlier_risk_score (NUMERIC): ORS (Outlier Risk Score, 0-100): Penny Stock(<1000KRW, 25pts) + Volume(low liquidity, 25pts) + Volatility(>80%, 25pts) + Market Cap(small cap, 25pts)
- risk_flag (VARCHAR): Risk grade based on ORS: EXTREME_RISK(>=80), HIGH_RISK(>=60), MODERATE_RISK(>=40), NORMAL(<40)
- alt_symbol (VARCHAR): Alternative stock code recommendation
- alt_stock_name (VARCHAR): Alternative stock name
- alt_final_grade (VARCHAR): Alternative stock investment grade
- alt_final_score (NUMERIC): Alternative stock final score
- alt_match_type (VARCHAR): Alternative match type (same_industry, similar_score, higher_quality, lower_risk)
- alt_reasons (JSONB): Alternative stock recommendation reasons JSON array
- value_rank (VARCHAR): Value factor rank ('X위' or '공동 X위' format)

- growth_rank (VARCHAR): Growth factor rank
- growth_percentile (NUMERIC): Growth factor percentile (0-100%)
- created_at (TIMESTAMP): Record creation time

WITH kr_momentum_value AS (
    SELECT 
        k.symbol,
        k.stock_name,
        'KR' as market,
        k.close,
        k.per,
        k.pbr,
        k.change_rate,
        kg.momentum_score,
        kg.value_score,
        kg.final_score,
        k.trading_value,
        CASE WHEN k.per < 15 OR k.pbr < 2 THEN 'attractive_valuation' ELSE 'normal_valuation' END as valuation_status
    FROM kr_intraday_total k
    JOIN kr_stock_grade kg ON k.symbol = kg.symbol AND kg.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM kr_stock_grade)
    WHERE k.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM kr_intraday_total)
      AND kg.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM kr_stock_grade)
      AND kg.momentum_score >= 80
      AND (k.per < 15 OR k.pbr < 2)
      AND k.per > 0 AND k.pbr > 0
),

    SELECT 
        u.symbol,
        COALESCE(ug.stock_name, u.symbol) as stock_name,

        u.pbr,
        u.change_rate,

      AND ug.momentum_score >= 80

      AND u.per > 0 AND u.pbr > 0
)

  o.avg_implied_volatility, o.total_call_volume, o.total_put_volume,

ORDER BY o.avg_implied_volatility DESC

WITH latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) as max_date FROM kr_intraday_total
),
moving_avg_support AS (
  SELECT 
    kit.symbol,
    COUNT(*) as days_above_sma,
    MIN(kit.close / ki.sma) as min_price_to_sma_ratio
  FROM kr_intraday_total kit
  JOIN kr_indicators ki ON kit.symbol = ki.symbol AND kit.date = ki.date
  CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
  WHERE kit.date >= ld.max_date - INTERVAL '9 days'
    AND kit.date <= ld.max_date
    AND ki.sma IS NOT NULL
    AND ki.sma > 0
  GROUP BY kit.symbol
  HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kit.close >= ki.sma) >= 8
    AND MIN(kit.close / ki.sma) >= 0.98
),
quant_qualified AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    stock_name,
    final_grade,
    final_score,
    value_score,
    quality_score,
    momentum_score,
    growth_score,
    confidence_score
  FROM kr_stock_grade
  WHERE final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수')
    AND value_score >= 70
    AND momentum_score >= 70
    AND confidence_score >= 80
)
SELECT 
  qq.symbol,
  qq.stock_name,
  kit.close,
  kit.change_rate,
  ki.sma as sma_20d,
  ROUND((kit.close / ki.sma - 1) * 100, 2) as price_vs_sma_pct,
  qq.final_grade,
  qq.final_score,
  qq.value_score,
  qq.quality_score, 
  qq.momentum_score,
  qq.growth_score,
  mas.days_above_sma,
  mas.min_price_to_sma_ratio,
  ki.rsi,
  kit.per,
  kit.roe,
  kit.market_cap,
  CASE 
    WHEN kit.market_cap >= 10000000000000 THEN '대형주'
    WHEN kit.market_cap >= 1000000000000 THEN '중형주' 
    ELSE '소형주'
  END as size_category
FROM quant_qualified qq
JOIN moving_avg_support mas ON qq.symbol = mas.symbol
JOIN kr_intraday_total kit ON qq.symbol = kit.symbol
JOIN kr_indicators ki ON kit.symbol = ki.symbol AND kit.date = ki.date
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
WHERE kit.date = ld.max_date
  AND kit.close >= ki.sma
  AND kit.per > 0 AND kit.per < 25
  AND kit.roe > 10
ORDER BY qq.final_score DESC, qq.value_score + qq.momentum_score DESC

WITH foreign_top AS (

    WHERE k.close > i.sma

## Question
업종별 상위 3위 종목들 중에서 외국인 보유 비중이 증가하고 있으면서 PER이 업종 평균보다 낮은 가치주를 찾아 상대강도와 함께 분석해주세요.

WITH sector_rankings AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    stock_name,
    market_cap,
    per,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 
      CASE 
        WHEN symbol LIKE '00%' THEN 'KOSPI_LARGE'
        WHEN symbol LIKE '03%' THEN 'KOSDAQ_IT'
        WHEN symbol LIKE '05%' THEN 'KOSPI_MANUFACTURING'
        ELSE 'OTHER'
      END 
      ORDER BY market_cap DESC
    ) as sector_rank,
    CASE 
      WHEN symbol LIKE '00%' THEN 'KOSPI_LARGE'
      WHEN symbol LIKE '03%' THEN 'KOSDAQ_IT'
      WHEN symbol LIKE '05%' THEN 'KOSPI_MANUFACTURING'
      ELSE 'OTHER'
    END as sector
  FROM kr_intraday_total
  WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM kr_intraday_total)
    AND market_cap IS NOT NULL
    AND per IS NOT NULL
    AND per > 0
),
sector_per_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    sector,
    AVG(per) as avg_per
  FROM sector_rankings
  WHERE per BETWEEN 1 AND 100
  GROUP BY sector
),
top3_by_sector AS (
  SELECT sr.*
  FROM sector_rankings sr
  WHERE sr.sector_rank <= 3
    AND sr.sector != 'OTHER'
),
foreign_flow_trend AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    SUM(foreign_net_value) as foreign_net_30d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN date >= (SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '10 days' FROM kr_individual_investor_daily_trading) 
             THEN foreign_net_value ELSE 0 END) as foreign_net_10d,

  FROM kr_individual_investor_daily_trading

  t3.stock_name,
  t3.sector,
  t3.sector_rank,

## Question
ROE 15% 이상이면서 부채비율 40% 이하인 재무건전성 우수 기업들 중에서, 최근 30일간 애널리스트 목표주가 상향이 있고 현재 퀀트 등급이 '매수' 이상인 종목들의 리스크 대비 수익성은?

WITH latest_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(d.date) as max_daily_date,
    MAX(g.date) as max_grade_date,
    MAX(bal.fiscal_date_ending) as max_balance_date
  FROM us_daily d, us_stock_grade g, us_balance_sheet bal
),
financially_healthy_companies AS (
  SELECT 
    b.symbol,
    b.stock_name,
    b.returnonequityttm as roe,
    bal.total_liabilities,
    bal.total_assets,
    CASE 
      WHEN bal.total_assets > 0 THEN (bal.total_liabilities::NUMERIC / bal.total_assets::NUMERIC) * 100
      ELSE NULL 
    END as debt_ratio,
    b.analysttargetprice,
    b.sector,
    b.market_cap
  FROM us_stock_basic b
  JOIN us_balance_sheet bal ON b.symbol = bal.symbol
  CROSS JOIN latest_dates ld
  WHERE bal.fiscal_date_ending = ld.max_balance_date
    AND b.returnonequityttm >= 15.0
    AND bal.total_assets > 0
    AND (bal.total_liabilities::NUMERIC / bal.total_assets::NUMERIC) <= 0.4
    AND b.analysttargetprice IS NOT NULL
),
target_price_changes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    symbol
  FROM us_stock_basic
  WHERE analysttargetprice IS NOT NULL
    AND updated_at >= (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM us_stock_basic) - INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT 
  fhc.symbol,
  fhc.stock_name,
  fhc.sector,
  d.close as current_price,
  fhc.analysttargetprice as target_price,
  ROUND(((fhc.analysttargetprice - d.close) / d.close * 100), 2) as upside_potential_pct,
  g.final_grade,
  g.final_score,
  ROUND(fhc.roe, 2) as roe,
  ROUND(fhc.debt_ratio, 2) as debt_ratio,
  g.var_95 as daily_var_95_pct,
  g.volatility_annual,
  g.max_drawdown_1y,
  g.sharpe_ratio,
  g.risk_reward_ratio,
  CASE 
    WHEN g.var_95 IS NOT NULL AND g.var_95 != 0 
    THEN ROUND((((fhc.analysttargetprice - d.close) / d.close * 100) / ABS(g.var_95)), 2)
    ELSE NULL 
  END as risk_adjusted_return,
  g.beta,
  fhc.market_cap / 1000000000 as market_cap_billions,
  g.conviction_score,
  g.entry_timing_score
FROM financially_healthy_companies fhc
JOIN us_daily d ON fhc.symbol = d.symbol
JOIN us_stock_grade g ON fhc.symbol = g.symbol AND g.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM us_stock_grade) AND d.date = g.date
JOIN target_price_changes tpc ON fhc.symbol = tpc.symbol
CROSS JOIN latest_dates ld
WHERE d.date = ld.max_daily_date
  AND g.date = ld.max_grade_date
  AND g.final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수')
  AND fhc.analysttargetprice > d.close
  AND g.var_95 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY risk_adjusted_return DESC NULLS LAST, g.conviction_score DESC
LIMIT 15

## Question
이번 주 거래량이 저번 주보다 많이 늘어난 종목들

WITH this_week AS (
    SELECT symbol, AVG(volume) as this_week_vol
    FROM kr_intraday_total
    WHERE date >= DATE_TRUNC('week', (SELECT MAX(date) FROM kr_intraday_total))
    GROUP BY symbol
),
last_week AS (
    SELECT symbol, AVG(volume) as last_week_vol
    FROM kr_intraday_total
    WHERE date >= DATE_TRUNC('week', (SELECT MAX(date) FROM kr_intraday_total)) - INTERVAL '7 days'
      AND date < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)
    GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT k.symbol, k.stock_name, k.close,
       tw.this_week_vol, lw.last_week_vol,
       (tw.this_week_vol / NULLIF(lw.last_week_vol, 0) - 1) * 100 as volume_change_pct
FROM kr_intraday k
JOIN this_week tw ON k.symbol = tw.symbol
JOIN last_week lw ON k.symbol = lw.symbol
WHERE lw.last_week_vol > 0
ORDER BY volume_change_pct DESC
LIMIT 20

## Conditions
- 과매수 -> rsi > 70
- 과매도 -> rsi < 30
- 골든크로스 -> macd > macd_signal
- 데드크로스 -> macd < macd_signal
- 대형주 -> market_cap >= 10000000000000 (10 trillion KRW)
- 중형주 -> market_cap >= 1000000000000 AND market_cap < 10000000000000
- 상한가 -> change_rate >= 29.9
- 하한가 -> change_rate <= -29.9

## Investor Types (Korean market only, from kr_individual_investor_daily_trading)
- 외국인, 외인 -> foreign_net_volume, foreign_net_value
- 기관 -> inst_net_volume, inst_net_value
- 개인, 개미 -> retail_net_volume, retail_net_value
- 순매수 -> net_volume > 0
- 순매도 -> net_volume < 0

## Question
최근 분기 매출액이 전년동기 대비 15% 이상 증가했고, ROE가 15% 이상이며, 기술적으로는 20일 이평선 위에서 거래되고 RSI가 50-70 구간에 있는 성장주를 부문별로 상위 3개씩 선별해주세요.

WITH latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) as max_date FROM us_daily
),
latest_income AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    fiscal_date_ending,
    total_revenue,
    LAG(total_revenue, 4) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY fiscal_date_ending) as revenue_yoy,
    CASE 
      WHEN LAG(total_revenue, 4) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY fiscal_date_ending) > 0 THEN
        ((total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue, 4) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY fiscal_date_ending)) 
         / LAG(total_revenue, 4) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY fiscal_date_ending)::NUMERIC) * 100
      ELSE NULL
    END as revenue_growth_yoy,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY fiscal_date_ending DESC) as rn
  FROM us_income_statement
  WHERE total_revenue IS NOT NULL
),
growth_stocks AS (
  SELECT 
    d.symbol,
    b.stock_name,
    b.sector,
    d.close,
    i.sma as sma_20d,
    i.rsi,
    b.returnonequityttm as roe,
    inc.revenue_growth_yoy,
    g.final_score,
    g.growth_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.sector 
      ORDER BY g.growth_score DESC, inc.revenue_growth_yoy DESC
    ) as sector_rank
  FROM us_daily d
  INNER JOIN latest_date ld ON d.date = ld.max_date
  INNER JOIN us_indicators i ON d.symbol = i.symbol AND d.date = i.date
  INNER JOIN us_stock_basic b ON d.symbol = b.symbol
  INNER JOIN latest_income inc ON d.symbol = inc.symbol AND inc.rn = 1
  INNER JOIN us_stock_grade g ON d.symbol = g.symbol AND g.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM us_stock_grade) AND d.date = g.date
  WHERE inc.revenue_growth_yoy >= 15
    AND b.returnonequityttm >= 15
    AND d.close > i.sma
    AND i.rsi BETWEEN 50 AND 70
    AND i.sma IS NOT NULL
    AND b.sector IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  symbol,
  stock_name,
  sector,
  close,
  ROUND(rsi, 2) as rsi,
  ROUND(roe, 2) as roe_percent,
  ROUND(revenue_growth_yoy, 2) as revenue_growth_yoy,
  growth_score,
  final_score,
  sector_rank
FROM growth_stocks
WHERE sector_rank <= 3
ORDER BY sector, sector_rank
